evidence.title: GitHub - avinashid/startx: Scaffold a production-ready TypeScript monorepo in minutes. · GitHub

name: startx
summary: CLI that scaffolds a production-ready Turborepo TypeScript monorepo with Next.js, React Router, Express and shadcn/ui packages.
description: A Turborepo starter scaffolded by the startx CLI: startx init creates the workspace, and startx package add/new copy template apps and packages into it later. Apps include Next.js 16, a React Router v8 SPA, an Express REST server, a Hono server on Bun, a Commander CLI and a queue worker; packages cover auth, Drizzle databases (PostgreSQL or SQLite), Redis, mail, logging, OpenTelemetry observability, a React UI library and AI utilities. AGENTS.md documents the conventions for AI coding agents.
contains: startx init, package list, package add and package new commands
apps: Next.js 16, React Router v8 SPA, Express server, Hono on Bun, CLI, queue worker
packages: env, lib, logger, mail, redis, observability, model, common, ui, queue, aix
databases: Drizzle with PostgreSQL or SQLite
shared configs: TypeScript, ESLint, Vitest, tsdown
AGENTS.md and a condensed agent skill for AI coding agents
